name: Evaluation of Textile Materials
description: Measurement of low-stress mechanical characteristics: bending, shear, tensile, frictional, and surface roughness characteristics in KESF systems and analysis of obtained test results. Measurement of transmission characteristics: thermal transmission; liquid transmission (wetting and wicking); moisture vapor transmission. Measurement of various technical textile materials: extreme heat and cold protective clothing, filter fabrics; fibre-reinforced composite materials, electromagnetic shielding textiles; ballistic protective textiles; UV protective textiles; cut protective textiles, automotive textiles for thermos-acoustic characteristics; etc. Analysis of test results.
